post.description:
Where each database named in the body is loaded: on a primary (with the regions serving it), on replicas only, or nowhere. A database is left out when the account does not own it, when its group's metrics could not be read, or when the cluster names a primary region the API does not know; the databases of a group whose liveness could not be checked answer Offline. A key granted named databases sees those only.

### Permission

`Database.Read` on the database collection.

200.description: The live status of each database asked for.

400.description: A body that is not JSON, names an unknown key, or carries a value of the wrong type (an id that is not `db_` and a ULID); or `DbIds` empty or over 250 ids.

401.description: Credentials missing or not accepted (an unknown, expired or revoked key or token), or an account the product is not enabled for.

403.description: An API key granted permissions, but not `Database.Read` on the database collection, or called from an address outside its allowlist; or a subuser without the `SubuserManage` role.

429.description: The account's request rate is over its limit; retry later.

500.description: The server failed; the detail names no cause.

get.description:
Get active stats for Databases.

A database is active while it is deployed on the cluster. An idle database is
stopped and is not active until its next request starts it again. Suspended
databases are not active.

### Permission

No permission grants it: the account API key or a JWT only.

200.description: The account's databases: how many, how many are live, their total size.

401.description: Credentials missing or not accepted (an unknown, expired or revoked key or token), or an account the product is not enabled for.

403.description: An API key carrying permissions (the operation takes the account API key or a JWT only), or a subuser without the `SubuserManage` role.

429.description: The account's request rate is over its limit; retry later.

500.description: The server failed; the detail names no cause.
